Bash: {
  "command": "python3 - <<'PY'
p='.claude/CLAUDE.md'; s=open(p).read()
anchor="- **One sessionId can have two live processes"
new="""- **A phone sign-in request IS a session prompt, and a prompt is announced the moment it appears — busy or not.** `phoneSignInPrompt` (`phone-sign-in-requests.ts`) turns a `waiting` request into the session's `prompt` (`source: "phone-sign-in"`, `options: []`, a `signIn` block), so needs-input grouping, the REST snapshot, the Live Activity row and the push all follow from the one primitive instead of a parallel field; `resolveSessionPrompt` and the watcher's `observeSession` both put a real transcript/pane prompt first. Two traps: (1) the push reducer used to return early while `busy`, but with hooks installed a session parked on AskUserQuestion is busy until answered — journal evidence showed every recent question answered before busy ever dropped, so no needs-input push had been firing; `reduceTransition` now emits on prompt-appearance and stays silent on the later busy→idle. (2) `withStitchedPreamble` must skip the sign-in prompt, and `POST /dismiss` refuses it (409) — Escape into the agent's waiting `browser-sign-in request` call would interrupt the turn. Restarting the server expires every `waiting` request on the host (the Chrome target reconnects with a new id); check `~/.lfg/phone-sign-in-history.json` for `waiting` rows before a restart. See `.claude/feature/phone-sign-in-needs-input.md`.
"""
assert s.count(anchor)==1; open(p,'w').write(s.replace(anchor,new+anchor)); print("CLAUDE.md updated")
PY
git status --short; git diff --stat | tail -3",
